## The problem

What need, fault, or question were you addressing? What measurable result would
count as success?

## My role and constraints

Explain your contribution, collaborators, materials, time, safety boundaries,
and other constraints.

## Initial design or prediction

Show the first idea and predict what will happen before testing.

## Build and evidence

Include only the calculations, diagrams, photographs, code, and measurements
needed to understand and verify the important decisions.

## Test results

| Test | Expected | Observed | Evidence | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Replace |  |  |  | pass / revise |

## Mistake and revision

Describe one meaningful problem, the evidence that exposed it, and the controlled
change you made.

## Final conclusion

State whether the evidence met the success criteria. Identify limitations and
the next useful test.

## What I learned

Explain one transferable skill and how you got unstuck.
